_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::reduced_airways#5, and the execution that corrected its Signal. There is no MAT_redAirway in 4C (MAT_REDAIRWAY_EXISTS=0) and the fix is not 'a different material per generation': the upstream 2-generation deck red_airway_3airway_2acinus_awacinter drives all three airways from ONE material, MAT_fluid (DISTINCT_AIRWAY_MATERIALS=1). Everything that varies by generation is an element-line token. Tapering Area 1.0 -> 0.5 on the two generation-1 airways moves node 2 pressure 29.8681 -> 29.9613 and WallElasticity 500 -> 5000 moves it to 29.9913, both with the material untouched, and 4C prints no warning for the uniform case. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Failed to match specification in section 'MATERIALS'.

_mutation.note: remove the per-generation geometry change: leave Area uniform in the TAPER arm. The result tests pass, EXIT_TAPER becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
remove the per-element wall change: leave WallElasticity alone in the WALL arm. EXIT_WALL becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
remove the invented-material probe: keep MAT_fluid. The MATERIALS match failure vanishes, EXIT_MATRED becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
